map.与增值税同为价外税。: Same as VAT, an add-on tax.

map.对比不同州销售税率的到手价差。: Compare take-home price gaps across state sales-tax rates.

map.税额 8 元、含税价 108 元，比 5% 多付 3 元。: Tax 8, inclusive 108, paying 3 more than at 5%.
